video_title: Austin Reaves Is “HILLBILLY KYRIE”?! Keyshawn on Luka & the Lakers

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Is Austin Reaves a legitimate number two option?
quotes.excerpt: Is Austin a legitimate number two in your opinion?

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Real quick before we get out, me and Max had this conversation last week and I want to hear your thoughts. Is Austin a legitimate number two in your opinion?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: Yeah, he is. If you look at Austin Reaves, he is. You are not asking him to be Drew Holiday on defense. You are just asking him to get in the lane, get in the way, and put the ball in the bucket.

quotes.social_post: Stephen Jackson believes Austin Reaves is a legitimate number two option for the Lakers, arguing that his ability to get in the lane and score makes him a top tier secondary option in the league.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating Austin Reaves as a number two option
quotes.excerpt: You are not asking him to be Drew Holiday on defense. You are just asking him to get in the lane.
quotes.quote: When you talk about twos, and you just think about twos when you played, or what people would call a two, or you can think about twos nowadays, who is better than him? You are not asking him to be Drew Holiday on defense. You are just asking him to get in the lane, get in the way, and put the ball in the bucket.
quotes.social_post: Stephen Jackson breaks down his criteria for a number two option, emphasizing that you do not need elite defense if the player can consistently get in the lane and put the ball in the bucket.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves' defensive effort
quotes.excerpt: They are making the effort on defense. They are not locking you, you do not have to lock nobody up.
quotes.quote: That is one thing I like about Luka and I think it is obviously contagious is they are making the effort on defense. They are not locking you, you do not have to lock nobody up, but just do not be a target or a weak link. And that is one thing both of them have put effort in on just being positional.
quotes.social_post: Matt Barnes praises the defensive effort from Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves, noting that while they are not lockdown defenders, their positional effort prevents them from being weak links on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Austin Reaves to other second options
quotes.excerpt: Who is better as a number two option in the National Basketball Association?
quotes.quote: I think he is like Hillbilly Kyrie. And I am not even talking about numbers. I am just talking about as a player, when you are watching that player, who is better? Who is better as a number two option in the National Basketball Association? Is it Donovan Mitchell? Is it Jalen Brown? Is it Tyrese Maxey?
quotes.social_post: Stephen Jackson calls Austin Reaves Hillbilly Kyrie and questions if he is a better number two option than stars like Donovan Mitchell, Jaylen Brown, or Tyrese Maxey.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's potential as a future star
quotes.excerpt: You know who is almost there, Dylan Harper on the Spurs.
quotes.quote: You know who is almost there, Dylan Harper on the Spurs. He showed in the finals last year. He is not considered their two. You think he is considered over five? Or Castle? Or Cissoko, or any of them? I think so.
quotes.social_post: Stephen Jackson highlights Dylan Harper as a rising talent for the Spurs, suggesting he is already making a significant impact alongside teammates like Castle and Cissoko.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's impact on the Dallas Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: Luka really did some work in Dallas. Now he had Kyrie, he had Lively and Kyrie.
quotes.quote: Luka really did some work in Dallas. Now he had Kyrie, he had Lively and Kyrie and some other dudes and a couple pieces, but he really put in work to get them to the Western Conference Final and into the NBA Finals. He has some players. He has some players on this team.
quotes.social_post: Stephen Jackson credits Luka Doncic for his heavy lifting in Dallas, noting that his ability to lead the team to the Western Conference Finals and the NBA Finals proves he has the right pieces around him.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's performance in recent games
quotes.excerpt: Luka was averaging 45, 9 and 8 in his last four.
quotes.quote: For last night's game, Luka was averaging 45, 9 and 8 in his last four. Obviously middle of the pack defensively, but one of the best offenses in the league.
quotes.social_post: Matt Barnes highlights Luka Doncic's recent tear, noting he is averaging 45, 9 and 8 over his last four games while anchoring one of the best offenses in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Teams to watch in the Western Conference
quotes.excerpt: I want to see San Antonio, I want to see OKC, I want to see Minnesota, and I want to see Denver.
quotes.quote: I want to see San Antonio, I want to see OKC, I want to see Minnesota, and I want to see Denver. I want to see them. And once I see them up against us, then I could get a little bit better judgment, maybe even Houston. I could kind of feel, get a feel for it.
quotes.social_post: Stephen Jackson identifies San Antonio, OKC, Minnesota, Denver, and Houston as the Western Conference teams he is most interested in watching to gauge the true landscape of the league.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's usage rate and scoring potential
quotes.excerpt: He has a 40 percent usage rate this season, which would probably be a record if it stays here.
quotes.quote: You were in the league when Kobe averaged 35 a game in 2006 and then you were just out of the league when Harden averaged 36. What do you think Luka can end up this year? He is at 40, right over 40 right now. He has a 40 percent usage rate this season, which would probably be a record if it stays here.
quotes.social_post: Matt Barnes and Stephen Jackson discuss Luka Doncic's historic 40 percent usage rate, comparing his scoring load to the legendary seasons of Kobe Bryant and James Harden.
